info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Streaming Subscriptions Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Status API provides real-time insights into the status of various streaming subscriptions within the system. This endpoint allows consumers to monitor active subscriptions, ensuring that they are up-to-date and functioning properly. Ideal for developers and system administrators, this API enables quick checks on subscription health, aiding in troubleshooting and performance optimization. Users can leverage this information to enhance user experiences by ensuring seamless access to streaming content.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to retrieve the current status of their subscriptions, providing insights into whether they are active, expired, or pending.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the necessary information to retrieve the subscription status. Ensure that the request adheres to the specified schema for proper processing.

201.description: Indicates that the subscription status was successfully retrieved.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsStatusRequest.description: A string representation of the subscription status request body for the GET operation.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsStatusResponse.title: Subscription Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the subscription status operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the reference of the operation.

resultId.description: A unique identifier for the result of the subscription status operation.

state.description: The current state of the subscription.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the status operation.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit trail of the operation.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsStatusResponse.description: The response schema for the subscription status operation that contains information regarding the current status of the subscription.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the record was created automatically.
